questions.prompt: Martin Luther's Ninety-five Theses challenged practices of which institution?
questions.fact: Printing presses spread the text across Europe within weeks, far faster than church authorities could respond.

questions.prompt: Which metal is liquid at room temperature?
questions.fact: Mercury is the only metal that is liquid at room temperature, which is why it filled thermometers for centuries — until its toxicity ended the practice.

questions.prompt: Which event crowns its winner with a wreath of olive leaves at the modern Athens marathon?
questions.fact: The course follows the road from the town of Marathon, and is notably uphill through its middle section.

questions.prompt: Which anonymous street artist is associated with Bristol and stencilled rats?
questions.fact: A canvas shredded itself moments after selling at auction in 2018, and the partly destroyed work later sold for far more.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Kenya?
questions.fact: It has a national park within the city limits, where lions and rhinos live against a skyline backdrop.
